source_window.dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) - Listed Building polygons, layer 3
source_window.data_date: 2026-09-01 (layer data last-edit date reported by ArcGIS REST metadata)

first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public physical building-footprint Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry for NHLE ListEntry 1306502 (Bridge Inn, Topsham, Exeter). The official NHLE record explicitly evidences an inn/coaching-inn building type/use, and the current official NHLE Listed Building polygons layer is an esriGeometryPolygon layer with ListEntry, Name and Grade bound to each feature. The exact single-record GeoJSON query payload could not be retrieved through the available web channel, and direct HTTP failed DNS resolution before any feature geometry could be read; therefore no geometry was inferred or fabricated and no individual building record was accepted.
